Set Up RRMS DES Model Inputs

rrmsdessetup.Rd

Usage

rrmsdessetup(
  drc = drc,
  drq = drq,
  time_horizon = time_horizon,
  p_eid = p_eid,
  jcvtest_cost = jcvtest_cost
)

Arguments

drc

Numeric. Annual discount rate for costs, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.035 for 3.5\

drqNumeric. Annual discount rate for QALYs, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.035 for 3.5\time_horizonInteger. Model time horizon in years.p_eidNumeric. Proportion of patients receiving extended interval dosing (EID) of Natalizumab, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.6 for 60\ for all patients.jcvtest_costNumeric. Unit cost (£) of a JC virus (JCV) antibody test. Set to 0 if the test is assumed to be provided free of charge (e.g. via manufacturer home service). Initialises all structural model parameters, treatment definitions, event states, and cost and utility inputs required to run the RRMS DES model. Must be called before rrmsdesmodel. rrmsdesmodel, summarise_ipd, plot_mortality_curves
